## 20000 - 20006

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="20000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />20000 INV - Mass exceeds fill limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="20000">

This validation and exception applies to Cavern and Inventory (created from Inventory Editor) Locations.

For each hour, FLOWCAL will compare the Mass Inventory amount on the Location to the Total Mass that is defined in the Validations on the location. If the Mass Inventory amount for the hour is greater than the Total Mass defined on the Location, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if the Total Mass on a Cavern Location is set to 100,000 and a Cavern Level Ticket is created with Mass set to 150,000, then this exception will be generated on the location.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="20001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />20001 INV - Volume exceeds fill limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="20001">

This validation and exception applies to Cavern and Tank Locations.

**Cavern Locations:** For each hour, FLOWCAL will compare the Gross Standard Volume Inventory amount on the Cavern to the Total Volume that is defined in the Validations on the location. If the Gross Standard Volume Inventory amount for the hour is greater than the Total Volume defined on the Cavern, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if the Total Volume on a Cavern Location is set to 100,000 and a Cavern Level Ticket is created with Gross Standard Volume set to 150,000, then this exception will be generated on the location because the Gross Standard Volume on the Ticket exceeds the Total Volume for that Cavern.

**Tank Locations:** For each hour, FLOWCAL will compare the Gross Standard Volume Inventory amount on the Tank to the Total Volume that is defined on the Capacity Table Data tab for the tank. If the Gross Standard Volume Inventory amount for the hour is greater than the Maximum Volume defined on the Capacity Table for the Tank, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if the Maximum Volume on the Capacity Table for the Tank is set to 200,000 and a Tank Gauge Ticket is created with Gross Standard Volume set to 205,000, then this exception will be generated on the location because the Gross Standard Volume on the Ticket exceeds the Maximum Volume for that Tank.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="20002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />20002 INV - Mass below low fill percentage</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="20002">

This validation and exception applies to Cavern and Inventory (created from Inventory Editor) Locations.

A Total Mass and Min Fill % is defined on the validations for the location. A Minimum Fill amount for the Location is determined by multiplying the Total Mass by the Min Fill %. For each hour, FLOWCAL will compare the Mass Inventory amount on the Location to the Minimum Fill amount for the Location. If the Mass Inventory amount for the hour is less than the Minimum Fill amount for the Location, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Total Mass on a Cavern Location is set to 100,000 and the Min Fill % is 10 %, so the Minimum Fill on the Cavern is 10,000 (100000\*10%). If a Cavern Level Ticket is created with Mass set to 5000, then this exception will be generated on the location because the Mass Inventory is lower than the Minimum Fill for the Cavern.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="20003">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="20003">

If a Cavern Level Ticket is created with Gross Standard Volume set to 5000, then this exception will be generated on the location because the Gross Standard Volume Inventory is lower than the Minimum Fill amount for the Cavern.

**Tank Locations:** A Min Fill % is defined on the validations for the tank, and the Total Volume is defined on the Capacity Table Data tab for the tank. A Minimum Fill amount for the Tank is determined by multiplying the Total Volume by the Min Fill %. If a Tank Gauge Ticket is created with Gross Standard Volume set to 15,000, then this exception will be generated on the location because the Gross Standard Volume Inventory is lower than the Minimum Volume amount for that Tank.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="20006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />20006 INV - Total changed when inventory not active</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="20006">

This validation and exception applies to Caverns, Inventory (created from Inventory Editor), and Tank Locations.

If the Gross Standard Volume Inventory or Mass Inventory value on the Location changes while the Location Status is set to Inactive, Long-Term Monitoring, or Plugged and Abandoned on the Characteristic tab for that Location, then this exception will be generated.

</div>
